Glasstual for macOS

IRC, made for the Mac.

A native IRC client for macOS 26 with a system sidebar, Liquid Glass and modern IRCv3.

Signed and notarized. Free and open source.

Features

Everything IRC, the way a Mac app should do it.

  • Search All History

    Search every stored conversation with Shift-Command-F and jump straight to the message in context.

  • Shortcuts and Spotlight

    Run Glasstual actions from Shortcuts. Servers and channels can appear in Spotlight, and direct conversations if you opt in. Only names are indexed, on your Mac, and you can turn it off.

  • Focus Filters and Idle Away

    Let a Focus filter quiet notifications, and set yourself away automatically when you are idle.

  • soju Bouncer Networks

    Connect to a soju bouncer once and see each of its networks nested under one account.

  • Modern IRCv3

    Multiline messages, message deletion, channel renames, replies, reactions, typing notifications, read markers and chat history, negotiated with each server.

  • Secure Sign-In

    SASL authentication, including ECDSA key pairs. Saved passwords stay in the macOS Keychain.

  • Transcript Log Viewer

    Browse saved transcript logs without leaving the app.

  • Ban and Exception Lists

    View and edit a channel's ban and exception lists in a native editor.

  • Network Icons

    Give each network an icon so it is easy to spot in the sidebar.

  • Native macOS 26 Interface

    A system sidebar, a Liquid Glass input field, and light and dark appearances that follow your Mac.

  • Made for Daily Use

    Multiple servers, favorites, unread filters, mentions, notifications, file transfers, message rules and user scripts.
